'''Unskette''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] nearly 900 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were passed.

==Biography==
Brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Unskette was assigned an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Clan]] and inducted into the [[Jedi academy|academy]] based out of the Temple. Graduating and selected to train by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Unskette eventually passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]]. After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of additional training the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] declared Unskette a Master, reaching the highest formal rank of the Order. At some point after that event, Unskette selected Initiate [[Thame Cerulian]] to become his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by his side.<ref name="TJP" />

During the pair's travels, Unskette and Cerulian faced three [[chain-sickle]] wielding [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] on [[Filve]]. Together, the Master-Padawan duo was able to overpower their adversaries, just barely. Assigned a mission on [[Orto/Legends|Orto]], the two Jedi were forced to contact the [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]] after being denied permission to take a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Force-sensitive child|infant]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. After many years together, Unskette recommended his faithful student for consideration to take the Trials. Passing each test presented by the Council, Cerulian and Unskette parted ways, their time as Master and Padawan at an end.<ref name="TJP" />
